'''Hril Bast''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], who worked for the [[Metatheran Cartel]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He represented the Cartel at the celebrations surrounding the [[Cularin Swamp Run/Legends|Cularin Swamp Run]] and later the [[Bazaar Star Challenge/Legends|Bazaar Star Challenge]].
